english.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a baked cookie in Hong Kong.

exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 faai3 kuk1 kei4 hou2 hoeng1

english.note: Use this specifically for sweet Western-style cookies, especially when distinguishing them from crackers.

exampleSentences.english: This biscuit is sweet and smells great.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 faai3 kuk1 kei4 tim4 tim4 dei2 hou2 hoeng1
